response.justification: Bogdan possesses extensive and highly relevant experience in geospatial data platforms, including designing and operating open-source GIS solutions which directly aligns with the role's industry and key responsibilities. While his recent primary language experience is not C++ or Rust, he has a solid background in C++ and Dlang, demonstrating strong systems-level programming capabilities and a proven ability to adapt to new technologies. His experience with high-throughput microservices and distributed systems is also highly relevant for building reliable and scalable data pipelines.
strengths: Extensive experience in geospatial data platform design and development (GISCollective, Green Map).
Demonstrated proficiency in systems-level programming (C++, Dlang) and distributed architectures.
Proven ability to adapt to new technologies and contribute across the full technical stack.
concerns: Recent primary language experience leans heavily towards Node.js/TypeScript, not C++ or Rust.
Specific experience in "routing tiling" or "navigation guidance solutions" is not explicitly detailed.
While strong in data platforms, direct experience with real-time traffic signal integration is not evident.
